question: What are the rulings for the card named and designed by Kev Walker? List them in descending order of dates.
evidence: rulings refers to text; card named and designed by Kev Walker refers to artist = 'Kev Walker'; descending order of dates refers to MAX(date);
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T2.text FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Kev Walker' ORDER BY T2.date DESC
gold0: SELECT T2.text FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Kev Walker' ORDER BY T2.date DESC

d.request: What is the ruling text for cards illustrated by Kev Walker? List the cards by their latest ruling date in descending order, including cards with no matching rulings record.
d.sql: SELECT c.name, r.text AS ruling_text, r.date AS latest_ruling_date FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.id = (SELECT r2.id FROM rulings AS r2 WHERE r2.uuid = c.uuid ORDER BY r2.date DESC, r2.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE c.artist = 'Kev Walker' ORDER BY r.date DESC NULLS LAST, c.name;

b.request: List the name and ruling text for each card with `artist = 'Kev Walker'`, including cards with no ruling, ordered by each card’s latest ruling date descending
b.sql: SELECT c.name, r.text AS ruling_text FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.id = (SELECT r2.id FROM rulings AS r2 WHERE r2.uuid = c.uuid ORDER BY r2.date DESC, r2.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE c.artist = 'Kev Walker' ORDER BY r.date DESC, c.name;

c.sql: SELECT c.name, r.text AS ruling, MAX(r.date) AS date FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Kev Walker' GROUP BY c.name, r.text ORDER BY MAX(r.date) DESC;
